facts.text: Rosewood Baha Mar is in Nassau, The Bahamas.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Baha MarNassau, The Bahamas

facts.text: Costa serves coastal flavors with creative Mexican flair, aimed at those who love fresh seafood.
facts.excerpt: Coastal flavors with creative Mexican flair. For those who love fresh seafood.

facts.text: Cafe Boulud The Bahamas serves traditional French cuisine in a Bahamian setting.
facts.excerpt: Traditional French cuisine in a warm inviting Bahamian setting.

facts.text: Manor Bar serves classic handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Classic handcrafted cocktails made with the finest spirits.

facts.text: Tingum on the Sand is a toes-in-the-sand dining experience.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a culinary adventure with our toes in the sand experience.

facts.text: At Tingum on the Sand no reservations are necessary; seating is first come, first served.
facts.excerpt: No reservations are necessary; seating is first come, first served

facts.text: The Library serves champagne, Bahamian bush teas and bites.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in champagne, Bahamian bush teas, and exquisite bites.

facts.text: Breakfast Cafe is an outdoor breakfast venue.
facts.excerpt: A vibrant outdoor escape where mornings burst with color, flavor, and island charm.

facts.text: Light meals and drinks are served at the pool and beach by the water's edge.
facts.excerpt: Light meals and refreshing drinks served by the water's edge

facts.text: Costa hosts a Sunday Mexican brunch crafted by Chef Juan Meza.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a luxurious Mexican brunch experience crafted by the talented Chef Juan Meza.

facts.text: Every Tuesday and Saturday, bartenders at Costa run a margarita-making class.
facts.excerpt: Every Tuesday and Saturday, enjoy an afternoon with our talented bartenders at Costa mixing up two versions of this popular cocktail

facts.text: Every Thursday afternoon Cafe Boulud offers Kristal Caviar with a selection of martinis.
facts.excerpt: Every Thursday afternoon at Café Boulud enjoy the rare delicacy of Kristal Caviar and a selection of finely crafted martinis.

facts.text: Costa offers tequila tastings.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to the tantalizing and sophisticated flavors of some of our favorite tequilas at Costa.

facts.text: The Ocean Guardian Experience is a guided snorkel through reefs and underwater sculptures.
facts.excerpt: Snorkel through reefs and striking underwater sculptures on a guided exploration of The Bahamas marine life.

facts.text: Hussey's Art Tour is a guided tour of local art and artists with a creative workshop and conversation over champagne.
facts.excerpt: Discover local art and artists through a guided tour, creative workshop and conversation over champagne

facts.text: Flamingo Yoga is a yoga class shared with flamingos.
facts.excerpt: A yoga class like no other, shared with graceful flamingos

facts.text: The Royal Blue Golf Course was designed by Jack Nicklaus and is an 18-hole, par-72 course.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the legendary Jack Nicklaus, Royal Blue is a spectacular 18-hole, par-72 course that winds its way through a naturally evolving tropical landscape.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Bahamian-inspired afternoon tea with local teas.
facts.excerpt: An unparalleled Afternoon Tea for savoring Bahamian-inspired indulgences and restorative local teas

facts.text: Multi-room suites with multiple bedrooms or connecting options suit families or groups.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families or groups, enjoy multiple bedrooms or connecting options.

facts.text: The oceanside villas have living spaces and residential amenities.
facts.excerpt: Our oceanside villas feature sophisitcated living spaces and residential amenities.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Discover effortless elegance where ocean vistas create the ultimate Bahamian sanctuary for luxurious relaxation and intimate gatherings.

facts.text: The Tailored Stay, in partnership with Bal Harbour Shops, gives access to a dedicated personal shopper.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your stay with exclusive access to a dedicated personal shopper, tailored to your individual style, travel plans, and experiences in The Bahamas.

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas are infused with the carefree spirit of coastal living.
facts.excerpt: Rooms, suites and villas infused with the carefree spirit of coastal living are a true escape into paradise.
